stem:
A respirometer can be used to investigate how temperature affects the rate of respiration of woodlice.

Woodlice are small invertebrate animals. Fig. 2.1 shows a single woodlouse.

{{figure:figure_2_1.png}}

Fig. 2.1

Fig. 2.2 shows a simple respirometer.

{{figure:figure_2_2.png}}

Fig. 2.2

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how the experimental set-up in Fig. 2.2 allows the rate of respiration of woodlice to be determined.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A student determined the rate of respiration of woodlice at a temperature of $5^\circ\text{C}$ and at a temperature of $20^\circ\text{C}$.

Predict **and** explain how the rate of respiration of woodlice differs at $5^\circ\text{C}$ compared to $20^\circ\text{C}$.
